english.title: Describe self as estate agent without placing information at business premises / on business documents
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person carrying on estate agency work,

(A)_[described yourself as an estate agent]_
(B)_[used a name or held yourself out as to indicate or reasonably be understood to indicate that you were carrying on a business in the course of which you were prepared to act as a broker in the acquisition or disposal of interests in land]_

(C)_[without displaying at your place of business]_
(D)_[including in a relevant document issued or displayed in connection with your business]_

prescribed information relating to arrangements authorised for the purposes of section 16 of the Estate Agents Act 1979
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16(4) and (6) of the Estate Agents Act 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
